title: Grateful Dead Live at Cleveland Public Hall on 1972-10-28
lineage: Master Reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CD

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard mix with a solid Dark Star that’s listenable despite slight drum heaviness.
ai_review.review: The recording is a partial sound‑board feed that offers a cleaner balance than the other mixes, though the drums sit a bit forward. Listeners find this Dark Star surprisingly focused and enjoyable for casual listening, even if they’re not fans of ultra‑spacey jams. Overall the performance is decent and the audio quality is far from unlistenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is judged solid but not exceptional (≈3.5/5) while recording is good (≈4/5); weighted average yields ~3.6. Mixed review scores and one non‑descriptive review lower confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is clearer than other feeds, less vocal/drum heavy but still slightly drum‑forward; sound described as fine and far from unlistenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only Dark Star is specifically discussed; no comments on overall set pacing.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums (Bill Kreutzmann) are noted as slightly heavier in this mix compared to other feeds.
